    About Uniswap

    UNI is the governance token of Uniswap, one of the largest decentralized exchanges, which uses automated market makers to swap tokens on Ethereum and many other networks.

    Where this UNI price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (UNI-USD), Binance (UNI/USDT) and Kraken (UNI/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 630,331,000 UNI (supply last updated November 8, 2026).
